outcome: Composite adverse neonatal outcome (occurrence of at least one of the adverse neonatal outcomes listed)
cohort: 265 women with PAS who underwent cesarean delivery matched to 1382 controls who underwent cesarean delivery without PAS
finding: Neonates born to mothers with PAS had higher rates of adverse outcomes compared to neonates born to mothers without PAS.
mod_finding: All women in the study, both with and without placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), underwent cesarean delivery.
